_doc: Claim registry for scripts/governance/ledger-truth.mjs. Each id maps a STATE claim written in the corpus to the read-only query that re-measures it. Queries are SELECT-only by construction — the gate refuses to run anything else. Keeping the SQL here and not in the markdown means a column rename breaks ONE file instead of thirty, and the CEO's documents never carry SQL.
_kind: Every entry answers: what does this number mean to a reader who acts on it?

agents_total.what: rows in the agent registry, every employment status included

agents_active.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM agents WHERE employment_status = 'active'
agents_active.what: employees the holding can actually put to work today

agents_archived.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM agents WHERE employment_status = 'archived'
agents_archived.what: retired registry rows, kept for history

agents_stale_persona_path.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM agents WHERE persona_path LIKE 'agency-agents/%'
agents_stale_persona_path.what: registry rows still pointing at the pre-v2 persona tree — the E12.5 gate demands 0

agents_legacy_version_live.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM agents WHERE persona_version = 'v1.0-legacy' AND employment_status <> 'archived'
agents_legacy_version_live.what: LIVE rows whose persona_version tag still says legacy; archived rows are deliberately left alone, so this counts only rows that can still feed a running agent

hr_employees_evaluated.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM audit_log WHERE action = 'employee.evaluated'
hr_employees_evaluated.what: employees that passed through the HR machine's evaluation step — the evidence that the draft to probation to active chain actually ran

library_items_total.what: records in the holding library catalogue

library_grants_live.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM library_grants WHERE expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now()
library_grants_live.what: capability grants in force — the record layer that governs what a department may reach for

library_usage_log_rows.what: times the workforce actually reached for a catalogued item; a full catalogue with zero usage is a shelf, not a toolkit (board row C31)

library_empty_kinds.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (VALUES ('prompt_template'),('workflow'),('framework'),('best_practice'),('lesson_learned')) AS k(name) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM library_items li WHERE li.kind = k.name)
library_empty_kinds.what: how many of the five operational-knowledge kinds hold zero rows — R4.2 left these to fill through real work, so this number is the measure of whether that happened

objectives_total.what: economic objectives the CEO has set

agent_runs_total.what: agent runs ever recorded — the difference between a company that exists and a company that works

voice_calls_total.what: voice calls recorded on the CEO's line

cost_ledger_rows.what: rows in the holding's own cost book. It is 0 while the earning machine is off by the CEO's decision, and that is the EXPECTED state, not a failure. The number exists as a named question so that a session can prove the company's book is untouched without ever holding a company credential — B36's one-way window answers it, nothing else has to.
